name: @dtc/portfolio-demo
description: Static portfolio demonstration of London Boy e-commerce with simulated local storage and demo admin

scripts.test: tsc --noEmit && node -e "const path = require('path'); const { createJiti } = require('jiti'); const jiti = createJiti(path.resolve('package.json')); jiti('./tests/storage.test.ts'); jiti('./tests/checkout-lifecycle.test.ts'); jiti('./tests/admin-operations.test.ts');"
scripts.test:unit: node -e "const path = require('path'); const { createJiti } = require('jiti'); const jiti = createJiti(path.resolve('package.json')); jiti('./tests/storage.test.ts'); jiti('./tests/checkout-lifecycle.test.ts'); jiti('./tests/admin-operations.test.ts');"
scripts.report:launch: node -e "const path = require('path'); const { createJiti } = require('jiti'); const jiti = createJiti(path.resolve('package.json')); jiti('./scripts/generate-launch-report.ts');"
scripts.media:capture: node -e "const path = require('path'); const { createJiti } = require('jiti'); const jiti = createJiti(path.resolve('package.json')); jiti('./scripts/capture-portfolio-media.ts');"
